item.cable.name: Logistics Cable
item.cable.description: Lays a cable across the ground. Chests and machines on or beside it join the network.
item.terminal.name: Storage Terminal
item.terminal.description: Browse, search and withdraw everything stored on the network from one screen.
item.crafting-terminal.name: Crafting Terminal
item.crafting-terminal.description: A storage terminal that can also craft using materials held anywhere on the network.
item.wireless-transmitter.name: Wireless Transmitter
item.wireless-transmitter.description: Broadcasts its network on a channel. Receivers on the same channel, anywhere, join it into one network.
item.auto-harvester.name: Auto-Harvester
item.auto-harvester.description: Tills, plants, waters, fertilizes and harvests an area you plan out. Seeds come from the network and the harvest goes into it.
item.wireless-receiver.name: Wireless Receiver
item.wireless-receiver.description: Joins its network to a transmitter's on the same channel, even from another building.
